why: Adamic, task r11wppy item 1, the public change: each member holds tsc's shared emptyArray (never[]) for a type with no members of that kind, so it is a readonly array. Code that pushes onto one, or assigns it to a mutable array, stops type-checking; code that reads it is unaffected.
